scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: node scripts/gradlew.mjs build -x test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: node scripts/gradlew.mjs test && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.db:clear: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U grainzon -d grainzon -c "TRUNCATE products RESTART IDENTITY;"
